body: Convert PDF to markdown + JSON quickly with high accuracy
plain_description: **Turn business documents into usable, structured content quickly.** Convert PDFs, images, and office files into Markdown, JSON, HTML, or chunks. Extract tables and images, with an optional LLM to improve results.
technical_description: Marker converts PDFs, images, and office documents into Markdown, JSON, HTML, or chunks. It supports OCR and layout analysis across CPU, GPU, and Apple Silicon MPS modes, and offers a command-line tool, Python API, interactive web viewer, and local FastAPI server. Optional LLM services can improve conversion quality.
title: Marker
